Main.dc.html.title: Character creator v1a · Guided steps: one step per screen, hex pips along the top. Swatches, heads and hairstyles are placeholders; the mini is a stand-in for the 3D model

Creator-v1b-PaintingTable.dc.html.title: Character creator v1b · Painting table: the mini on a worktable, tool trays in any order, paint pots for colours. Same placeholders as v1a

Creator-v1c-OriginBoard.dc.html.title: Character creator v1c · Origin board: class, ancestry and background are hex tiles placed around the mini; tap a placed tile to finish its details. Same placeholders as v1a

Creator-v2a-ClassTiles.dc.html.title: Character creator v2a · Class step: bigger class hexes on top, the picked class's blurb, main scores, gear and level-1 kit below. God is its own step after Class (Clerics only). Steps after God are as in v1a

Creator-v2b-ClassList.dc.html.title: Character creator v2b · Class step: classes as a full-height list, details on the right with Back and Next inside them (like level-up v9b). God step and later steps as in v2a

Creator-v2c-ClassCards.dc.html.title: Character creator v2c · Class step: six class cards with main scores and level-1 kit; tapping one opens the level-up style pop-up over the mini with Choose. God step and later steps as in v2a

Creator-v3-ClassSpacing.dc.html.title: Character creator v3 · v2a with spacing fixed: no title row (the pips name the step), smaller class hexes, the blurb on one line, facts and level-1 kit side by side, casters' spell slots without a repeat line

Creator-v4a-FullScreen.dc.html.title: Character creator v4a · Full-screen choices: no mini until Look. Class and God are hanging banners across the whole screen; the picked one widens and reveals its blurb, facts and level-1 kit. The mini rises in at Look. Banner colours (each class's quest terrain, each god's terrain) are placeholders

Creator-v4b-Legend.dc.html.title: Character creator v4b · The legend: no mini until Look. A parchment page on the left writes the hero's legend as you pick (class blurb, god, race and trait, background and starting place, then scores, proficiencies, gear and spells). At Look the mini rises in its place

Creator-v5a-Stitched.dc.html.title: Character creator v5a · Stitched: v4a's banners with the details sewn straight onto the cloth (no white card). A stitched line under the name, main scores as hex badges, facts on the left, a stitched seam, then the level-1 kit

Creator-v5b-Patches.dc.html.title: Character creator v5b · Patches: the details as sewn-on cloth patches in a shade of the banner (main scores, armour, weapons, level-1 kit), each with a stitched edge

Creator-v5c-Heraldry.dc.html.title: Character creator v5c · Heraldry: a centred crest (emblem, name, blurb), a stitched divider, main-score badges beside weapons and armour, and the level-1 card hanging from the banner's tip like a charm (its effect text isn't shown)

Creator-v6-CardDetails.dc.html.title: Character creator v6 · v5c chosen, with card details: tap the hanging level-1 card (or a god's free spell) to open a pop-up above it, in the level-up pop-up style, with what it does, its AP and any use limit. Tap again or the X to close. Spell slots stay plain

Creator-v7a-SubInBanner.dc.html.title: Character creator v7a · Race step, sub-types in the banner: picking a race widens its banner; a row of sub-type pills sits under the blurb (dragon types in their colours), and picking one swaps in its name, blurb and trait. The racial card hangs from the tip. Race emblems and colours are placeholders

Creator-v7b-SubStep.dc.html.title: Character creator v7b · Race step, then its own sub-type step: the race banners show the race blurb, boosts and the sub-types to come; a Sub-type / Dragon type / Bloodline pip follows Race (skipped for Humans and Halflings) with its own banners, blurbs, traits and racial card

Creator-v7c-Pennants.dc.html.title: Character creator v7c · Race step, sub-types as pennants: picking a race hangs a rod of small pennants across its banner's foot (dragon types in their colours); the picked one drops lower and glows, and its blurb and trait fill the banner. The racial card hangs from the same rod

v2.text: v2 · guided steps: the class step three ways, God as its own step

v4.text: v4 · building the idea first: no mini until Look

v5.text: v5 · v4a's banners: the details on the cloth, three ways

v6.text: v6 · v5c's heraldry, the hanging card opens its details
